events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in Bethel, New York, from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since a generation gathered for three days of peace and music. What's your favourite memory from Woodstock, or the acts who played there?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977, and would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and legend live on.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocks harder than most. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher, known for his distinctive vocal style and outspoken personality, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher turns 54 today! The iconic Oasis frontman is still bringing the swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over 60 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The celebrated British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic genius. What's your favourite sketch or line?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering Freddie Mercury, the iconic Queen frontman, who passed away on November 24, 1991, and would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: A True Champion
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
